texts:
Michael Wilson has 30 targets in his last two games. The stove's on in Arizona, and he is the biggest riser of Week 4.

WR44 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a bench WR3. Let's get into it.
#BirdGang

Michael Wilson, ARI WR: targets 7, 7, 17, 13.
Trade for him; offer a bench WR3.

Marvin Harrison Jr., ARI WR: 9 targets in three games, under 80 percent of the snaps each week.
WR43 for me. Sell; ask for a bench WR3 with a full-time role.
#BirdGang

Kyren Williams, LAR RB: targets 7 to 13, and 70 snaps to Blake Corum's 13 @PHI. A career-high 10 catches.

RB16 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3 and a bench RB.
#RamsHouse

Tetairoa McMillan, CAR WR: targets 5 to 16. 14 catches for 192 and 2 TDs vs DET.

WR20 rest of season for me. Trade for him during the bye; offer a WR2.
#KeepPounding

Carnell Tate, TEN WR: targets 9 to 12, about 39 percent of Tennessee's in Week 4. The rookie is the first read now.

WR34 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a bench RB or a WR4.
#TitanUp

Isaiah Likely, NYG TE: snap share 49, 69 and 84 percent, then 12 targets vs ARI.

TE13 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a TE in the 14 to 18 range and a bench piece.
#NYGiants

Brock Bowers, LV TE: 13 targets, then a team-high 11 vs KC. 16 catches for 202 and 2 TDs in two games back.
TE2 for me. Trade for him; offer a WR2 and a TE in the 10 to 14 range.

Michael Mayer, LV TE: 10 targets vs KC.
TE-premium add, 0 to 2 percent.
#RaiderNation

Kyle Monangai, CHI RB: 30 carries for 146 and 2 TDs vs NYJ. The thumb imaging was clean.
Claim him, 10 to 20 percent of FAAB.

D'Andre Swift, CHI RB: 15 carries, a fumble, then the bench.
RB13 for me. Monitor the carry split @GB Sunday.
#DaBears

Keaton Mitchell, LAC RB: snap share 25 to 38 percent, then 15 touches to Hampton's 9 @SEA.
Claim him, 4 to 8 percent.

Omarion Hampton, LAC RB: snap share 58, 63, 42 percent.
RB12 for me. Sell; ask for a top-15 RB who catches passes.
#BoltUp

Will Shipley, PHI RB: 28 of 61 snaps vs LAR, the last healthy back with Bigsby on IR.
Claim him, 10 to 15 percent.

Darius Cooper, PHI WR: 55 of 61 snaps, a team-high 7 targets.
Add him, 1 to 3 percent.
#FlyEaglesFly

Denzel Boston, CLE WR: snap share 87 to 95 percent. Cleveland's leading receiver in three of four games.

WR46 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a bench RB.
#DawgPound

Left to cool.

Josh Downs, IND WR: targets 3, 9, 11, then 4 in London, even with Pierce on IR and Allen out.

WR35 rest of season for me. Monitor his targets Sunday; another game under 5 makes him a sell.
#ForTheShoe

Jeremiyah Love, ARI RB: carries 21 to 14 @NYG, and Tyler Allgeier scored. He tweaked his other ankle and the staff is managing his workload.

RB14 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's practice report before DET.
#BirdGang

J.K. Dobbins, DEN RB: snap share 52 to 42 percent @SF while RJ Harvey caught 10 passes. 3.5 a carry on the season.

RB32 rest of season for me. Sell; ask for a bench RB with a clearer role.
#BroncosCountry

Jacory Croskey-Merritt, WAS RB: snap share 57 to 45 percent, and 9 carries for 15 in London. Austin Ekeler took 17 snaps in his first game.

RB35 rest of season for me. Sell; ask for a bench WR with a role.
#RaiseHail

James Cook III, BUF RB: a season-low 59.3 percent of the snaps vs NE, and Ty Johnson ran 15 routes on 19 snaps.

RB7 rest of season for me. Monitor his snap share @LAR Monday night.
#BillsMafia #RamsHouse

TreVeyon Henderson, NE RB: snaps 33, 23, 25. Rhamondre Stevenson out-snapped him 35 to 25 @BUF and took the score.

RB24 rest of season for me. Monitor the snap split vs LV Sunday.
#NEPats

Xavier Hutchinson, HOU WR: Nico Collins came back to 69 percent of the snaps and caught 7 for 118 and 2 TDs.

The Weeks 2 and 3 targets go back to Collins. Drop Hutchinson for any add.
#HTownMade

Every riser and faller, with the number behind each call, is on the site. Follow @FF_ChefHazy so you catch the next trend first, and like this if it moved your lineup.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/heat.html?week=5
